setup: You are comparing three fractions to one half.

steps.say: One half is the benchmark that needs no common denominator: a fraction exceeds a half exactly when twice its numerator beats its denominator, which is a comparison of two whole numbers.
Applying that to each of the three gives \([[count]]\) of them above a half. The benchmark works because a half is the one fraction whose numerator and denominator are the easiest to double.

answer: So \([[count]]\) of the three fractions are greater than one half.
